apiVersion.description: APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object. Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and may reject unrecognized values. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description: Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents. Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to. Cannot be updated. In CamelCase. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

crossplane.description: Configures how Crossplane will reconcile this composite resource

database.description: Database configures the managed database attached to this Microservice.

image.description: Docker image to deploy on the provisioned VM (e.g. adminer:4.8.1).

port.description: TCP port the container listens on. Used to build the status endpoint and open the security group. Defaults to 8080.

writeConnectionSecretToRef.description: Writes database connection details (host, port, database, username, password, endpoint) to this Secret once the Microservice is Ready.

spec.description: MicroserviceSpec defines the desired state of a Microservice.

databaseHost.description: MySQL host (public IP of the DBaaS Elastic IP).

deployedImage.description: Docker image that was last successfully deployed. Used to short-circuit SSH on reconciles when nothing has changed.

endpoint.description: HTTP endpoint to reach the deployed application once Ready=True.

subnetUri.description: Internal — Subnet URI propagated from composed Subnet resource.

vpcUri.description: Internal — VPC URI propagated from composed VPC resource.

status.description: MicroserviceStatus defines the observed state of a Microservice.

description: Microservice provisions a VM, a managed MySQL database, and deploys a Docker image configured with database connection env vars.
